tracks.name: Aurora & City Lights (Test)
tracks.description: High-contrast Earth night visualization with glowing cyan bioluminescent ocean currents on the left, a dark central void, and golden-amber city lights with orange atmospheric streaks on the right.
tracks.whyItMatters: Demonstrates how two contrasting planetary stories—oceanic and human—can be heard simultaneously in stereo.

tracks.name: Night Lights 2012–2023
tracks.description: NASA Black Marble satellite view of Earth at night, showing bright urban corridors and sparse illuminated settlements against dark oceans and continents.
tracks.whyItMatters: Tracks human settlement growth, energy access, and urban sprawl across the globe.

tracks.name: Sea Surface Currents & Temp
tracks.description: Procedural preview placeholder representing swirling ocean boundary currents and sea surface temperature gradients. Upload real SVS 3912 frames to hear the original NASA imagery.
tracks.whyItMatters: Ocean currents redistribute heat across the planet and drive regional weather and marine ecosystems.

tracks.name: GEOS Aerosols
tracks.description: NASA GEOS-5 simulation showing three distinct aerosol families: orange/red dust, green organic smoke, and blue/cyan sea salt.
tracks.whyItMatters: Aerosols affect air quality, cloud formation, and how much sunlight reaches Earth's surface.

tracks.name: Air Quality Model Runs
tracks.description: Procedural preview placeholder representing smooth regional air pollution plumes drifting across continents. Upload real SVS 5533 frames to hear the original NASA imagery.
tracks.whyItMatters: Forecasting pollutant plumes helps communities prepare for unhealthy air quality events.

tracks.name: Perpetual Ocean 2
tracks.description: Procedural preview placeholder representing continuous global ocean eddies and thermohaline circulation streams. Upload real SVS 5425 frames for original NASA imagery.
tracks.whyItMatters: Reveals the interconnected, swirling circulation that links every ocean basin.

tracks.name: DYAMOND Global CO₂
tracks.description: Procedural preview placeholder representing smooth atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration fields across hemispheres. Upload real SVS 5196 frames for original NASA imagery.
tracks.whyItMatters: Shows how carbon dioxide emissions mix through the atmosphere and respond to seasonal plant uptake.

tracks.name: ISS Lightning 2017–2023
tracks.description: NASA ISS Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS) visualization showing sharp, high-contrast electrical flash density hotspots over dark continents and oceans.
tracks.whyItMatters: Lightning frequency tracks severe convective storms and shifting climate patterns.

tracks.name: Atmospheric River 3D
tracks.description: Procedural preview placeholder representing narrow moisture corridors streaming from the tropics toward coastlines. Upload real SVS 4960 frames for original NASA imagery.
tracks.whyItMatters: Atmospheric rivers deliver vital water supplies—and extreme flood risks—in concentrated bursts.

tracks.name: GEDI Forest Height
tracks.description: NASA GEDI lidar visualization of global forest canopy height, highlighting dense tall tropical rainforests and boreal timberlines.
tracks.whyItMatters: Forest height measures above-ground carbon storage and biodiversity habitat structure.
